mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3+ months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which triggers a shift in Fed policy toward rate cuts, boosting equity risk appetite and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in private demand, which increases the likelihood of Fed intervention and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05) or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 in two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which increases recession risk and triggers a flight to safety, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 105.0 for two months (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal produces positive returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 238.0 with a 12-month increase exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which increases real rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 238.0 and 12-month change > 3.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal has Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both GDP (GDPC1) and residential construction (HOUST) signals strong underlying demand momentum, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST rise in the same quarter (t-test p > 0.05) or the joint signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200k in a single month, combined with a stable unemployment rate, signals labor market overheating, which increases the probability of Fed rate hikes and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE < 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction signal has Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 106.0 for three consecutive months, combined with a rising unemployment rate, indicates a supply-side shock with labor market stress, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 106.0 for 3 consecutive months and UNRATE > 4.8%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 106.0 for 3 months and UNRATE > 4.8% (t-test p > 0.05) or the joint signal produces positive returns in > 50% of triggered instances.
